# José María Castro

José María Castro is a freelance web developer and Senior Full Stack Developer based in Alcobendas, Madrid, Spain.

## Services

- Professional websites for local businesses, independent professionals and small companies.
- Fast, cost-conscious delivery with direct communication.
- Landing pages, business websites and custom web applications.
- .NET, C#, React, Next.js, Node.js, SQL Server, integrations and automation.
- Technical SEO, Google Search Console and consent-aware Google Analytics setup.

## Service area

Alcobendas, San Sebastián de los Reyes, Madrid and remote projects across Spain.
